# netactuate_router_vrf_tunnel (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages a GRE tunnel in a cloud router VRF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_vrf_tunnel" "example" {
  endpoint_address_remote = "192.0.2.10"
  ip_key                  = 1000
  mtu                     = 1500
  name                    = "example"
  router_id               = 12345
  vrf_id                  = 12345
  ipv4_cidr               = "192.0.2.1/30"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint_address_remote` (String) The remote (destination) IP address for the tunnel endpoint.
- `ip_key` (Number) The GRE key to associate with the tunnel.
- `mtu` (Number) The MTU for the tunnel.
- `name` (String) Name your tunnel something you'll use to refer to it in other configurations.
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the VRF.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description for the tunnel.
- `ipv4_cidr` (String) An IPv4 address to apply to the tunnel interface.
- `ipv6_cidr` (String) An IPv6 address to apply to the tunnel interface.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_address_source` (String) The source IP address for the tunnel endpoint.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_version` (Number) The IP version of the tunnel.
- `tunnel_id` (Number) The ID of the tunnel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_vrf_tunnel.example 12345
```
